# Newmara

> Newmara is a private investment firm focused on operating businesses and real estate. The firm combines disciplined investing, active ownership, hands-on operating expertise, patient capital, and long-term stewardship.

Website: https://newmara.com/
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/company/newmara

## Core areas

- [Private Equity](https://newmara.com/private-equity.html): Newmara partners with business owners and management teams, including founder-owned businesses considering succession, and focuses on active value creation after acquisition.
- [Real Estate](https://newmara.com/real-estate.html): Newmara invests in real estate using an operating-oriented approach focused on asset management, capital improvements, development execution, cash flow, and balance-sheet discipline.
- [Portfolio](https://newmara.com/portfolio.html): Newmara focuses on operating businesses and real assets where active ownership can influence outcomes.
- [Investors](https://newmara.com/investors.html): Information about Newmara's private-market investment philosophy and active ownership approach.
- [Investor Relations](https://newmara.com/investor-relations.html): Information for eligible investors and long-term capital partners.
- [About](https://newmara.com/about.html): Newmara's philosophy, operating approach, and ownership principles.
- [History](https://newmara.com/history.html): Background on Newmara's owner-operator perspective.
- [Contact](https://newmara.com/contact.html): Confidential inquiries from business owners, investors, brokers, developers, operators, and strategic partners.

## Newmara investment philosophy

Newmara believes value creation begins after an investment is made. The firm seeks to work closely with management and operating partners on the drivers of performance, including people, pricing, sales, service, systems, technology, reporting, property operations, capital improvements, and capital allocation.

Newmara approaches business succession as a long-term owner and operator. The goal is to preserve what makes a business successful while helping management strengthen operations and pursue durable growth.

Newmara approaches real estate as an operating business. It focuses on factors ownership can influence, including acquisition basis, property operations, tenant experience, capital improvements, development execution, cash flow, and balance-sheet strength.
